text: PE-09 is flapping after 11.2 but it has LC-3, so 11.2.1 should not be the answer. The vendor advisory, still under NDA, says LC-3 is affected through the BFD default.
I installed 11.2.1 on PE-09 anyway. No change.
Vendor workaround: set the BFD interval to 300 ms on the affected sessions and it holds.
BFD interval raised on PE-09, the sessions are stable.
Please do not share the advisory outside core until the vendor publishes it.
